name: scrcpy
description: Android device screen mirroring and control over USB/WiFi with minimal latency

adb.description: Android Debug Bridge for device communication and debugging
adb.usage:
adb devices
adb shell
adb install app.apk
adb pull /sdcard/file.txt .
adb push file.txt /sdcard/

scrcpy.description: Display and control Android devices over USB/WiFi with low latency
scrcpy.usage:
scrcpy
scrcpy -s DEVICE_ID
scrcpy --max-size 1024
scrcpy --record file.mp4
scrcpy --turn-screen-off
